title: 5/27 dashboard /health timed out while the service was active (single-threaded HTTPServer); dashboard restart needed
tier_reason: dashboard surface hung (it is display, not the delivery path) and would have failed a deploy canary; restored by a dashboard-only restart with the scheduler untouched

contract.text: The dashboard answers /health promptly whenever its service is active, so the deploy canary and the operator can rely on it.
contract.source: docs/superpowers/runbooks/2026-05-23-alert-disposition.md '2026-05-27 Dashboard Health Canary Follow-up' (c127673); CLAUDE.md Deployment (canary checks dashboard HTTP)

mechanism.text: web.py served with Python's single-threaded HTTPServer, so one slow or stuck request blocked every other request, including /health, although the process stayed alive and TCP-accepting

mitigated.action: dashboard-only restart (bts-dashboard.service) restoring /health=ok, scheduler left running

verified_recovered.how: after the restart /health returned ok while bts-scheduler stayed active with NRestarts=0 (operator report)

watchdog.trigger: the dashboard unit is active but /health on its bind address does not answer within a few seconds on two consecutive probes
watchdog.recovery_assertion: /health returns ok on the next probes after the restart, with the scheduler untouched

evidence.locator: docs/superpowers/runbooks/2026-05-23-alert-disposition.md '2026-05-27 Dashboard Health Canary Follow-up' (added by c127673)
evidence.what: during the PR #136 deploy-safety checks bts-dashboard.service was active and TCP-accepting but /health timed out; a dashboard-only restart restored /health=ok while bts-scheduler stayed active with NRestarts=0; cause: single-threaded HTTPServer

the previous deploy, 2026-05-26T18:39:23Z (14:39 ET), restarted bts-dashboard; the hung process started no earlier than this (unless restarted by hand later)

notes: prelim OI?/B: the runbook entry is explicit and same-day, so observed
what request wedged the server is not recorded; bts-dashboard's own journal (B2, not exported by W0.7) could show it
alert none: no monitor watched dashboard /health outside deploys; the operator found it in pre-deploy checks
